description: Land Acquisition - Abhayapura, Town & Gravets D/S Division, Trincomalee District - Ihala Kobeigane, Kobeigane D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific parcels of land (including lot numbers, boundaries, extents, and locations) for public purposes (Post Office building construction project). The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative procedures, compensation claims, and property descriptions, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
